card.name: Prepositions after name-given and contraindicated
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after a verb or participle that expects a following phrase, such as 'given' or 'to' after 'the name', and 'in' after 'contraindicated'. Also 'of' after 'results' and 'on' after 'builds'.

modes.label: Naming phrases
modes.description: 'given' or 'to' after 'the name' or 'the term', introducing what something is called.
modes.example: REBECCA RIOTS, the name given<< to>> some disturbances which occurred in 18

modes.label: Contraindicated in
modes.description: The word 'in' right after 'is contraindicated' in label text before a patient group.
modes.example: Gatifloxacin ophthalmic solution 0.5 % is contraindicated<< in>> patients with a history of hypersensitivity to

modes.label: Other verb-plus-preposition links
modes.description: A linking word after a verb or noun that introduces a study, source or target.
modes.example: The study builds<< on>> previous research by senior author Christina A.

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word toward the start of a new phrase, not toward a specific word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that follows 'the name given' or 'contraindicated' and leads into the next phrase.
